title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-17
lineage: Set 1: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) -> FLAC/16
source: Set 1: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) Set 2: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Dolby C)

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard recording with bright tone, strong second‑set energy and standout jams like Eyes and Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its high‑energy second set, memorable jams and Bobby McCracken’s vocal phrasing on Scarlet Begonias into Fire. Recording quality is generally good for an early‑80s SBD tape – bright and clear in places but with occasional tape‑flip cuts, reduced bass and hot vocals.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars for the musical performance; recording notes are mixed but lean toward decent soundboard quality, resulting in a solid combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Bright and clear in parts, but suffers from typical early‑80s SBD issues: occasional tape‑flip cuts, reduced bass response, and hot vocal levels.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set largely ignored by listeners; second set highlighted for its jam intensity and seamless transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted for briefly pausing to appreciate Bobby’s phrasing during the Scarlet Begonias > Fire jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: His vocal outro on “Estimated” and phrasing in the Scarlet Begonias > Fire jam are singled out as highlights.
